description.value: Boardwalk Cafe & Games is a board game cafe in downtown Abbotsford offering food, drinks, and access to a library of nearly 1,000 games. Guests can dine in, order takeout, or have food delivered, and the venue hosts weekly trading card game leagues, D&D sessions, trivia nights, and other community events. It is a lively, social stop with table service and private rooms available for groups.
